title: STP Basics
description: Understand how STP prevents loops and identify the root bridge.
scenario: Understand how STP prevents loops and identify the root bridge.

concepts.title: Why STP?
concepts.body: Without STP, redundant links create broadcast storms and MAC table instability. STP blocks redundant paths to create a loop-free topology.
concepts.code:
Redundant links → loops
STP → blocks one path → no loops

concepts.title: Root Bridge Election
concepts.body: The switch with the lowest bridge priority + MAC address becomes the root bridge. All other switches calculate the best path to root.

concepts.title: Port Roles
concepts.body: Root ports (best path to root), designated ports (forward), and blocked ports (prevent loops).
concepts.code:
Root Port: best path to root
Designated: forwards traffic
Blocked:   prevents loops
